title: Turkey with Gravy, Dressing, Potatoes and Vegetables (Frozen Meal)

content.title: About
content.content: Turkey with gravy, dressing, potatoes and vegetables is a ready‑to‑heat frozen meal designed for quick preparation in a microwave or oven. It contains a portion of turkey breast covered in a savory gravy, a side of potatoes, mixed vegetables, and a creamy dressing. One serving provides roughly 350 kcal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Turkey is one of the leanest meats and is often used in health‑focused diets.
Frozen ready meals save time while preserving flavor when stored properly at –18 °C.
The gravy is made from chicken broth and aromatic herbs, giving it a rich taste.
The combination of potatoes and vegetables offers a balance of carbs, fiber, and vitamins.
This product was launched in 2023 as part of the “Quick Dinner” line.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Turkey breast contains very little saturated fat, making the meal suitable for heart‑healthy eating.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: A single serving delivers about 25 g of protein, essential for muscle repair and satiety.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Turkey provides vitamin B6 and niacin, which support metabolism.

items.title: Fiber from vegetables and potatoes
items.content: Helps regulate digestion and maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: The meat supplies heme iron, important for hemoglobin formation.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Prepared sauces often contain added salt; people monitoring blood pressure should account for this.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to turkey.

items.title: Proper heating required
items.content: Uneven heating can leave cold spots where bacteria may survive.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: The product may contain stabilizers and antioxidants that are not suitable for everyone.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in the microwave for about 3–4 minutes or in a conventional oven at 180 °C for roughly 20 minutes. Stir before serving to coat the turkey and sides evenly with gravy. For extra freshness, garnish with chopped herbs or a squeeze of lemon.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen meal at –18 °C or lower. Once thawed, consume within 2 hours and do not refreeze. Discard if you notice off‑odors or discoloration.
